capabilities: Look up English and Japanese words in a note via free dictionaries and an OpenAI-compatible AI model
Save looked-up words to a word list with source note and sentence, and review them on a customizable schedule
Underline saved words while reading, including conjugated Japanese verb and adjective forms
Export saved words to Anki through AnkiConnect or to a Spaced Repetition flashcard note
Quick-translate a selection into Chinese or Japanese
disambiguation: Despite the general name, it only handles English and Japanese lookups, not arbitrary languages.
extras: The manifest carries the directory's 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice. SiliconFlow rejects even free models while the account balance is zero; some dictionary sources are scraped web pages that may return empty if site layouts change. Includes a signed build provenance attestation for releases and a migration path from the older plugin ID obsidian-polyglot-helper.
problem: Looking up a word means leaving the note for dictionary sites, and Obsidian has no built-in way to save words, see them again while reading, or review them over time.

relations.evidence: Send to Anki in one command through the AnkiConnect add-on
Export to a Spaced Repetition flashcard note or an Anki import file

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible AI provider (DeepSeek preset; OpenAI, Gemini or Youdao for Japanese speech)

summary: Dictionary and AI-powered lookup that builds study cards for English and Japanese words and reviews them on a spaced schedule.
